scope: May single-identity engineering pilot; no training in data preparation
scoring_pcm: unaltered source PCM16 channel 0; same for all gains and trained models
driver_format: mono WAV IEEE_FLOAT64; no resampling, limiting, or per-utterance normalization
audio_encoder: official frozen AVE, eval mode, strict original checkpoint

provider_contract.boundary_attention: provider selects supervised rows before temporal attention; first/last 4 rows are flagged as attention-edge and excluded from primary evaluation clips

formal_cohort_requirements.source: real single-person AV, no dubbing, no music, no clipping, no detected scene cuts inside selected blocks
formal_cohort_requirements.split: recording or contiguous-time blocks before audio encoding; source intervals must not overlap
formal_cohort_requirements.selection: technical/source quality only; never select by TFG or SyncNet improvement
formal_cohort_requirements.identity_count: freeze after multi-identity variance/cost pilot; 6-10 is a budget proposal, not a power guarantee
formal_cohort_requirements.upstream_exposure: record known and unknown pretraining exposure; no automatic clean-domain claim
